coverage_limits: Canonical fixture has no case-colliding or duplicate titles; case-fold/tie ordering cannot be discriminated on those data.
Feedback checks validate nonempty accessible status/alert semantics, not the linguistic quality of every message.
Keyboard checks cover focus reachability, Apply and quest activation; custom widget keyboard internals and broader accessibility need review.
Read-only HTTP behavior and immutable inputs are checked; absence of dormant authentication, database or other out-of-scope code needs source review.
Finite tests are acceptance evidence, not proof for all possible programs. Criterion-level disclosure audit and live-runtime admission remain separate.
scoring: All 23 critical automated criteria, plus protected-input gate; full denominator is fixed across prompt levels. Subset diagnostics never yield full-target acceptance.
